authority: Privileged PostgreSQL metadata read and role-authenticated SELECT transactions; no frontend mocks in live counters
session_method: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; set_config(request.jwt.claim.sub, QA auth uid, true); SELECT authorized public helpers / COUNT(*) under RLS; ROLLBACK

role_predicates.interpreted_contract: Parish only owns own parish; diocese/chancery read own diocese and parishes therein; general admin cross-jurisdiction; only diocesan role can manage legacy import with unscoped parameters; all unauthorised scope false

sacramental_rls.interpretation: COUNT(*) visible with authenticated SQL role was compared against the privileged expected totals grouped by parish and diocese, without selecting identity/record content

negative_cases_interpretation: A successful count comparison under RLS is specific to read access for 4 tables and 12 QA identities. It does not validate all mutations, grants, decree semantics, disabled user revocation, backup or an official production database.
source_sql_example: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '<existing fictional QA UUID>', true); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.baptisms; ROLLBACK;
